name: wrc-video
description: Wild Rift Core — short vertical videos (TikTok / Shorts / Reels) rendered from the site's weekly data with Remotion. English only.

scripts.cues: for f in $(node scripts/formats.mjs); do npx tsx scripts/cues.mts --format=$f; done
scripts.audio: for f in $(node scripts/formats.mjs); do node scripts/synth-audio.mjs --format=$f; done
scripts.voice: for f in $(node scripts/formats.mjs); do npx tsx scripts/export-voice.mts --format=$f; done
scripts.stills: for f in $(node scripts/formats.mjs); do npx tsx scripts/stills.mts --format=$f; done
scripts.render:all: for f in $(node scripts/formats.mjs); do npx remotion render src/index.ts $f out/$f.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --log=error || exit 1; done
scripts.render: npm run sync && npm run clips && npm run cues && npm run audio && npm run voice && npm run render:all
